reason: The first implementation described one-step recovery but --execute would continue through later missing steps. That was unsafe under the observed long-call transport failure that orphaned the original PowerShell launcher.
current_behavior: audit-only mode reports the first missing lawful step
--execute runs exactly one missing lawful step
the step is verified before return
a RESUME_STEP_RECEIPTS.jsonl record is appended for each executed step
partial or corrupt output remains a hard stop
completed output is hash/identity checked before it is skipped
